questions.q: Which constitutional body audits the accounts of the Union and states?
questions.solution:
The Comptroller and Auditor General (Article 148) audits the accounts of the Union and the states.

**Answer: Comptroller and Auditor General**

questions.q: Which type of emergency has never been proclaimed in India?
questions.solution:
A Financial Emergency under Article 360 has never been proclaimed; national emergencies and President's Rule have both been imposed.

**Answer: Financial Emergency**

questions.q: Who has the power to appoint the Advocate General of a State?
questions.solution:
Article 165 empowers the Governor to appoint the Advocate General of the state.

**Answer: Governor**
questions.shortcut: Governor appoints the state's law officer.

questions.q: What is the frequency range of sound that can be heard by the human ear?
questions.solution:
The human ear hears sound roughly between 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz.

**Answer: 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz**

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a work written by William Wordsworth?
questions.solution:
Hyperion is an unfinished epic by John Keats; The Excursion, Intimations of Immortality and Michael are all Wordsworth's works.

**Answer: Hyperion**

questions.q: Which of the following is the largest contributor to urban PM2.5 in India?
questions.solution:
Vehicle exhaust is the largest single contributor to urban PM2.5 levels in Indian cities.

**Answer: Vehicle exhaust**

questions.q: Which of the following meteorological factors can reduce Air Quality Index (AQI) temporarily?
questions.solution:
Rain washes pollutants out of the air (wet deposition), temporarily lowering the AQI; humidity, calm winds and inversions all worsen it.

**Answer: Rain**

questions.q: Neeraj Chopra won his first-ever gold medal in javelin at the Asian Games in which year and city?
questions.solution:
Neeraj Chopra won his first Asian Games javelin gold at Jakarta 2018 with an 88.06 m throw.

**Answer: 2018, Jakarta**

questions.q: What are anabolic steroids primarily used for by athletes who misuse them?
questions.solution:
Athletes who misuse anabolic steroids do so mainly to build muscle mass and strength.

**Answer: Build muscle mass**

questions.q: Which element is required by the thyroid gland to produce thyroxine?
questions.solution:
The thyroid gland needs iodine to synthesise thyroxine; its deficiency causes goitre.

**Answer: Iodine**

questions.q: The Goods and Services Tax Council is chaired by:
questions.solution:
The GST Council is chaired by the Union Finance Minister (Article 279A).

**Answer: Finance Minister of India**

questions.q: Aurangzeb's long Deccan campaigns mainly aimed at subduing
questions.solution:
Aurangzeb's decades-long Deccan campaigns were aimed chiefly at subduing the rising Maratha power.

**Answer: The Marathas**
questions.shortcut: Marathas drained Mughal power in the Deccan.

questions.q:
Which of the following are target groups for PM-DAKSH Scheme which is seen in news in July 2025?

I. Scheduled Caste

II. Other Backward Caste
questions.solution:
PM-DAKSH provides skill training to Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes and economically backward sections, so both I and II are target groups.

**Answer: Both I and II**
questions.shortcut: SCs + OBCs + EBCs are its groups.

questions.q: Which Pallava king defeated and killed Pulakesin II?
questions.solution:
Narasimhavarman I of the Pallavas defeated and killed Pulakesin II and captured Vatapi in 642 CE.

**Answer: Narasimhavarman I**

questions.q: 'Kambala' festival is celebrated in which of the following Indian state?
questions.solution:
Kambala, the traditional buffalo race, is celebrated in coastal Karnataka.

**Answer: Karnataka**

questions.q: The 3-day International Bird Festival 2025 was organised at ____ from 16 to 18 February 2025.
questions.solution:
The 3-day International Bird Festival 2025 was organised at Prayagraj from 16 to 18 February 2025.

**Answer: Prayagraj**

questions.q: Who delivered a speech in Bombay on January 15, 1908, declaring that the purpose of national education was to awaken the spirit of nationalism among students?
questions.solution:
Sri Aurobindo Ghose delivered that speech in Bombay on 15 January 1908, linking national education with nationalist awakening.

**Answer: Sri Aurobindo Ghose**

questions.q: The ______ religious group saw the highest decadal population growth rate in India between the 2001 and 2011 censuses.
questions.solution:
Between the 2001 and 2011 censuses the Muslim community recorded the highest decadal growth rate (about 24.6%).

**Answer: Muslim**

questions.q:
Which of the following is NOT the way to finance a budgetary deficit?

I. Borrowings II. Taxation
questions.solution:
A budgetary deficit is financed through borrowings and deficit financing; taxation is an ordinary revenue receipt, not a way of financing the deficit, so only II is NOT a way.

**Answer: Only II**
questions.shortcut: Taxation is revenue, not deficit financing.

questions.q: The Operation Gideon Chariots is associated with which of the following country?
questions.solution:
Operation Gideon's Chariots is a 2025 Israeli military operation in Gaza.

**Answer: Israel**
